content.comment_body: Hi, I have this [product_name] hardware, model [version_no] with reference [article_no]. I understand that with [product_name] software I can configure this [product_name] CPU as a MODBUS TCP/IP slave, but I don't have the software yet and want to ensure the hardware is compatible with [version_no] before purchasing. Please advise. Thank you, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. To select a [product_name] [version_no] or higher in the device list, you need at least [product_name] V8.1, though it's best to use the latest V8.2.1. If you have a full licensed version (not demo), you can update to the newest release at no cost. Note that registration is required for downloading due to export restrictions.
Not all [product_name] [version_no] units with order number [article_no] support Modbus TCP/IP. You need at least production status FS4 or higher.
Hi, if your [product_name] [version_no] with marked FS:04, it's best to perform a firmware update first. Link to firmware update [url]. Hope this helps.

I have the same issue. I'm working with [product_name] V8.1 and my hardware is [article_no], FS:04. Do I need to update anything? Can I configure this hardware as a server? What device should I choose in the configuration software?

For Modbus TCP/IP, you need a [product_name] [version_no] with FS:04 status or higher. There is a firmware update for FS:06 available here: [url]. Also, you should install the latest software, [product_name] V8.2.1, which you can download here: [url]. The included firmware update does not apply to your [product_name]. The configuration for server (slave) or master (client) is set in the connection options.
I have [article_no]. Someone mentioned I need [article_no]. Is this correct?

A [product_name] with order number [article_no] does not exist. The order number for the current model is [article_no]. You need the latest model only for using the advanced web server; your device has only the basic web server. Both support Modbus TCP/IP.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for assurance regarding the compatibility of their [product_name] hardware and correct software version to enable Modbus TCP/IP slave features. They have questions about hardware versions (FS:04 or higher), firmware updates, and order numbers, which lead to confusion about available functionalities. Having updated software and firmware is crucial for feature access.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear confirmation and guidance on whether their [product_name] hardware supports Modbus TCP/IP slave mode with the correct firmware and software, aiming to avoid unnecessary software purchases or updates.
